project.name: Desk Dry Run ($0)
project.goal: A rehearsal of the trading-research desk, run entirely on the mock runtime so it costs nothing. The company plans, proposes requirements, creates tasks, claims them, files evidence and trips every guardrail exactly as it would with real agents — the only difference is that no model is called. Use it to find out what your constitution actually does before you point real money at it: watch the queue ceiling refuse a seventh task, watch the drought block internal busywork, watch the plan gate refuse a plan that does not fit the budget, and watch a bet expire on its kill date. Produce a short written record of which rules fired and which numbers you would change.
